summary: Greenfield bootstrap and import-payload no longer copy __pycache__ or *.pyc from the installed plate-core payload tree.
migration_impact: New bootstraps and import-payload runs omit bytecode. Repos that already committed scripts/plate/__pycache__/ may delete those paths and add local gitignore rules (#1460).
agent_notes: After upgrading plate-core, re-run import-payload only if you need refreshed scaffolding; remove any previously copied __pycache__ under scripts/plate/ from git history if present.
